$comment: Example Claude Code hooks configuration. Merge the `hooks` object into your Claude Code settings.json (~/.claude/settings.json or .claude/settings.json) — Mori does NOT install it for you. Replace ABSOLUTE_PATH with the real path to mori-claude-hook.sh (macOS / Linux) or mori-claude-hook.ps1 (Windows). The script forwards each event to mori-claude-hook.py, which writes typed connector JSONL to ~/.mori/connectors/claude-code/. Output is summary metadata only — no prompt or tool payloads are stored.
